audit.why: EVEN 5.5/10 is defensible at WR 46.78 over 885 games: Hwei wins range early and scales, Taliyah wins levels 3-5 and roams; slightly Hwei-sided overall, which the chart already reflects (Hwei 3 rows, Taliyah 2, Skill 2).

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer level chart is blanket 'Skill' on all rows; packet levelChart and content win[] agree: Hwei rows 0-1, Taliyah rows 2-3, Skill 4-5, Hwei row 6.
audit.why: Kit-grounded: Hwei's QW missile out-ranges Taliyah level 1 and his pools zone at 2; from 3 worked-ground Q out-shoves and W-E punishes step-ups; both ults are utility so 6 is even; late his layered zone control out-scales.
audit.corrected: Full sides aligned with rewritten whys; rows 4-5 left Skill.

audit.whatIsWrong: FABRICATED ABILITY NAME across the full layer: 'Subject: Fear (CC Paints)' — Hwei's CC palette is Subject: Torment (E). It appears in winCon, enemyWin, loading, focus.text, breakdown.cooldowns, breakdown.feeding, dosFull[2].d, report[1/3/5/9]. Content 'early' also names 'QW (Devastating Fissure)' — the real QW is Severing Bolt (QQ Devastating Fire, QE Molten Fissure). The Serenity (W) shield force-out (missingInteractions) was absent; cooldowns had no digits.
audit.why: Kit: E Subject: Torment 12/11.5/11/10.5/10s carries the hardCC palette; W Subject: Serenity 18s carries the shield; Q costs 80-120 mana.
audit.corrected: Every occurrence renamed to Subject: Torment (E); Severing Bolt fixed; 12s/18s numbers and shield sequencing added.
